full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Facilitation of Cooperation in Local Agriculture and Fisheries Development Projects and the Enforcement Decree thereof, and matters necessary for their enforcement.
